methodology_lessons: CapEx figures alone do NOT prove water system demand — must find specific water infrastructure projects (SMIC lesson: 18.357B CapEx ≠ water system, but Fab9 Phase II 2.957B civil works DO prove it)
Production timeline matters: signals about projects already in mass production have MISSED the primary water system construction window (BYD Phase 1 Feb 2026 → water system likely complete)
Enrichment agents may create signals based on non-public information that cannot be independently verified — such signals must be downgraded to Watchlist (Huakang Pharma 5-fluorocytosine expansion)

For industrial park signals, distinguish between park-level infrastructure and enterprise-level water systems, and clarify procurement model (Longyan: zero-discharge park tender + enterprise MVR evaporation)
Corporate structure matters: parent/subsidiary relationships affect project ownership and decision chain (Huahai Jianchang = Huahai Pharma subsidiary; BYD Xuzhou = BYD Freud + Huaihai Holdings JV)
